question: Is the previous full-cell validation wrong? (bare cortex 4 kPa vs whole-cell ~182-249 Pa)
answer: No. The bare-cortex modulus is a POINT on the loading/relaxation spectrum, not a compartment effect. Even the previously-validated harness (ff_hertz_validation) gives ~1.5 kPa in its GENERIC drained mode; the IN-BAND ~249 Pa needed a SPECIFIC fully-relaxed (slowest-rate + membrane + turnover) config. My S1 (drained, rigid, native) is consistent with the validated harness (drained, soft).
note: E_fit [Pa] at NF=2000 CPU unless '(native)'. rigid vs soft plate = ~1.6x. MCF7 whole-cell band 224-279 Pa.
